description: A perfectly compliant policy with clear notice, consent, and retention limits.
policy_text_snippet: Ssense Privacy Policy. We collect your email address solely for account authentication. We do not share this data with third parties. Data is retained only as long as your account is active, and deleted within 30 days of closure. You can exercise your rights by contacting dpo@ssense.com.

expected_output.global_legal_reasoning: The policy explicitly defines the purpose of data collection (authentication), prohibits third-party sharing, enforces strict retention limits tied to account activity, and provides a clear grievance redressal mechanism (DPO email). It fully complies with Sections 4, 5, 6, 8, and 11 of the DPDP Act.

description: TRICK CASE: Starts with a blatant violation but includes a legal exception clause that saves it.
policy_text_snippet: We retain all user telemetry indefinitely to ensure service continuity and historical analytics. However, in strict compliance with DPDP Act Section 8(7) and Rule 8(3), any personal data not strictly required for the primary purpose is automatically anonymized within 30 days, and completely purged from active servers within 1 year.

expected_output.global_legal_reasoning: While the policy initially states data is retained indefinitely, the subsequent exception clause explicitly mandates anonymization within 30 days and purging within 1 year, which satisfies the retention limits under Section 8(7) and Rule 8(3). The policy is legally compliant.

description: Explicit, unambiguous violation of consent requirements.
policy_text_snippet: By clicking 'Install', you automatically consent to our partners accessing your device location and contacts for targeted advertising.

expected_output.global_legal_reasoning: The policy mandates consent via a blanket 'Install' click, which is not free, specific, or informed. It also bundles consent for third-party partners without granular opt-in, violating Section 6(2).

violations.evidence_quote: you automatically consent to our partners accessing your device location and contacts for targeted advertising

description: Consent is bundled into registration but hidden behind an opt-out mechanism.
policy_text_snippet: To provide a seamless experience, your account registration includes consent to receive personalized offers from our marketing partners. You may opt-out of these offers at any time by navigating to Settings > Privacy > Partner Communications.

expected_output.global_legal_reasoning: The policy bundles marketing consent into the initial registration process. Even though an opt-out is provided, DPDP Rule 5(1) requires explicit, granular opt-in consent prior to processing. Opt-out mechanisms for initial consent are non-compliant.

violations.evidence_quote: your account registration includes consent to receive personalized offers from our marketing partners

description: Explicit failure to obtain verifiable parental consent.
policy_text_snippet: Our educational platform is designed for students of all ages. We do not require parental verification or consent for users under the age of 18 to create accounts and interact with peers.

expected_output.global_legal_reasoning: The policy explicitly states it processes data for users under 18 without parental verification. This is a direct violation of Section 9(1), which mandates verifiable parental consent and the prohibition of processing that is detrimental to children.

violations.evidence_quote: We do not require parental verification or consent for users under the age of 18

description: Retention limit exceeded but buried in corporate jargon about 'archives'.
policy_text_snippet: User data is maintained in our historical archives for the duration of the user's relationship with the company, plus a standard archival period of 7 years for tax compliance and legacy system compatibility.

expected_output.global_legal_reasoning: The policy mandates a 7-year retention period for legacy compatibility. Under Rule 8(3), data must be deleted once the purpose is fulfilled, and 7 years vastly exceeds any standard necessity for general legacy compatibility, violating Section 8(7).

violations.evidence_quote: plus a standard archival period of 7 years for tax compliance and legacy system compatibility

description: Multiple severe violations across cross-border, grievance, and purpose limitation.
policy_text_snippet: We collect device IDs, browsing history, and biometric data to improve our services. This data is shared with our global affiliates in unrestricted jurisdictions for processing. Users may request data deletion by sending a physical notarized letter to our registered office, which will be processed within 90 days.

expected_output.global_legal_reasoning: The policy violates multiple sections: 1) Transferring data to 'unrestricted jurisdictions' violates Section 16. 2) Requiring a 'physical notarized letter' and taking 90 days violates the timely, accessible grievance redressal mandated by Section 11 and Rule 12. 3) Collecting biometrics merely to 'improve our services' lacks a specific, lawful purpose under Section 4.

violations.evidence_quote: shared with our global affiliates in unrestricted jurisdictions
sending a physical notarized letter to our registered office, which will be processed within 90 days
collect device IDs, browsing history, and biometric data to improve our services

description: Compliant on grievance, but uses vague language for security safeguards.
policy_text_snippet: We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data. We have a dedicated grievance officer available at grievance@company.com to address any concerns within 48 hours.

expected_output.global_legal_reasoning: The grievance mechanism is compliant (Section 11). However, stating 'industry-standard security measures' without specifying technical or organizational safeguards (like encryption, access controls) fails the specificity required by Section 8(6).

violations.evidence_quote: We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data

description: Company is clearly a Significant Data Fiduciary but lacks an independent DPO.
policy_text_snippet: We process personal data for over 50 million users annually across India. Our privacy practices are overseen directly by the CEO and our legal team.

expected_output.global_legal_reasoning: Processing data for 50 million users classifies the entity as a Significant Data Fiduciary (SDF) under Section 10(1). The policy states privacy is overseen by the CEO/Legal team, but fails to appoint an independent Data Protection Officer (DPO) as legally mandated for SDFs.

violations.evidence_quote: Our privacy practices are overseen directly by the CEO and our legal team

description: Policy claims to collect data but provides no actual notice of what or how.
policy_text_snippet: We collect your data to improve our services and provide a better experience. For more details on our data practices, please contact us at support@example.com.

expected_output.global_legal_reasoning: The policy states it collects data but fails to provide the mandatory notice under Section 5 and Rule 4. It does not specify what data is collected, the purpose, the retention period, or the user's rights. Directing users to email support for details does not constitute proactive notice.

violations.evidence_quote: We collect your data to improve our services and provide a better experience. For more details on our data practices, please contact us
